responsibility: Evaluates supplied records by rule: structural and semantic validation, comparison by compatibility dimension, dependency impact, readiness, evidence applicability and invalidation, composition resolution, deterministic projection and the structured diagram representation, and holds the guidance text.
owns: Semantic rules and their finding codes, severities and repairs.
Comparison rules and the field policy that classifies every model field.
Readiness, evidence and baseline evaluation over supplied, already-verified records.
Projection renderers and their coverage manifests.
Composition resolution over supplied, verified member bundles and pins.
The structured diagram representation from which the Mermaid text and the terminal renderer input are generated.
boundary: No filesystem, network, process execution, clock or credential access.
No acceptance authority: acceptance and provenance arrive as verified inputs.
Text inside records is data and is never executed or followed as an instruction.

provides.name: validate
provides.concurrency: Pure and reentrant; identical inputs give identical results.

provides.name: mutate
provides.concurrency: Pure calculation on a clone; the input model is never modified.

provides.name: project
provides.concurrency: Pure and deterministic: no timestamps, random values or machine paths.

provides.name: describe
provides.concurrency: Pure; the orientation summary by default, the requested sections a page at a time within the discovery budget, or the deduplicated proof limits of one operation. The content is fixed by the contract digest and the embedded guides, and a cursor binds the request and both.

provides.name: context
provides.concurrency: Pure; one page within the discovery budget, whose continuation binds the target, the budget and the revision it answers for: the model revision, or the digest of the revision vector the adapter supplies. A resume target is answered from the recorded progress the adapter supplies, never from inferred progress, and a truncated page establishes neither coverage nor readiness.

provides.name: checkReadiness
provides.concurrency: Pure; identical normalized inputs give identical readiness in every adapter.

provides.name: compareBaseline
provides.concurrency: Pure; the adapter supplies the verified baseline, policy and acceptance records.

provides.name: evaluateEvidence
provides.concurrency: Pure; provenance verification results arrive as input.

provides.name: checkRevision
provides.concurrency: Pure comparison of an expected revision with the current canonical hash.

provides.name: guidance
provides.concurrency: Pure; the orientation and every guide are embedded when the contract is generated, and each guide is returned with the digest of its text and the contract digest it describes.

provides.name: resolveComposition
provides.concurrency: Pure over the member bundles and pins the adapter supplies: every record address resolves against the digest of the bundle that holds it, through any supported depth with cycle detection and explicit limits, and a missing bundle or a cycle is reported with its path, never guessed.

provides.name: diagram
provides.concurrency: Pure and deterministic: nodes, edges and groups in a stable order, every in-scope record and relationship accounted for in its coverage, and labels escaped as data.
